
All options specific to device `virtual:virtual_scanner':
    --mode Color [Color]
        Selects the scan mode (Color)
    --resolution 50..600dpi (in steps of 50) [300]
        Sets the resolution of the scanned image in DPI
    -l 0..215.9mm [0]
        Top-left x position of scan area
    -t 0..297mm [0]
        Top-left y position of scan area
    -x 0..215.9mm [215.9]
        Width of scan-area.
    -y 0..297mm [297]
        Height of scan-area.
